text:
Alyssa: Hey — quick question for tonight's quiet window in uk-west. We need a short GPU slot (A100) for a 4h overnight inference sweep. Who's the owner for allocs tonight?
Ben: I can help if it's just a short run, what time window are you thinking?
Alyssa: Targeting 01:00-05:00 UTC so it doesn't hit peak demo traffic.
Carmen (devops): FYI we have a soft-standby rotation. I need the tenant id & cost center to carve a temp slice. Also if you can use a preemptible mix that'll help.
Alyssa: Tenant: rwd-infra-loadtest, cost center: infra-eng-sweeps. Preemptible is fine as long as jobs checkpoint.
Ben: Cool. @Carmen can you reserve A100 x1 in uk-west1 for that window? If quota blocks, fallback to an a40 with RDMA flag.
Carmen (devops): Checking now. Quick sanity command I'm running:
```
gcloud compute reservations create overnight-sweep --zone=uk-west1-b --accelerator="type=nvidia-a100,replicas=1" --specific-reservation  
```
Carmen (devops): Hmm quota shows 0 free A100 in uk-west1-b but 2 in uk-west1-c. Do you care about the zone?
Alyssa: Zone ok to change as long as network egress to our staging bucket is <100ms. We can point to uk-west1-c.
Ben: If we shift zone, update the TF snippet in the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452 — Alyssa can you drop the run command there?
Alyssa: Done. I pushed the `run-over-night` job and added a small retry/backoff.
Liz (finance): Quick flag — please tag the run with cost_center=infra-eng-sweeps. Small runs add up overnight.
Alyssa: Will do, added `--labels=cost_center=infra-eng-sweeps` to the job.
Oncall-bot: Reminder: quiet-window bookings must be posted to #alloc-calendar 24h before start. (Automated check passed)
Ben: Noted. Alyssa can you post the booking link in #alloc-calendar?
Alyssa: Posted: https://calendar.redwood.ai/alloc/1748807777 — includes zone uk-west1-c, A100 x1, 01:00-05:00 UTC, checkpointing enabled.
Carmen (devops): Reservation created: `overnight-sweep-1748807777` in uk-west1-c. I set preemptible=true fallback=false (we grabbed a dedicated slot).
Alyssa: Amazing, thanks! I'll kick off at 01:05 UTC and monitor. Ping me if anything preemptive shows up. :thumbsup:
Ben: I'll watch logs during the window. If you want, I can add a short smoke test to verify model loads before heavy traffic.
Alyssa: Yes please — small smoke test would be great. I've added `smoke: true` to the job config.
Carmen (devops): All set from infra side. If anything changes, I'll DM the oncall.
Oncall-bot: oncall alert channel set to #eng-oncall for this reservation.
Liz (finance): Thanks for tagging — will reconcile costs tomorrow.
Alyssa: Closing the loop. Thanks everyone!
